newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares set new highs in big volume.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares set new highs in big volume.

text.p: 1610 GMT - Portuguese shares closed at a record high in exceptional volume of over 18 billion escudos, driven along by the strength of Wall Street, end-month operations and some "dividend-washing" on Portugal Telecom.

*The telecommunications operator accounted for some 45 percent of the volume, with its price ending just 0.25 percent higher at 6,405 escudos against a 0.73 percent rise for the PSI20 .PSI20 index of leading stocks.

*The outlook for Friday would depend on how Wall Street closed on Wednesday and Thursday, which is a holiday in much of Europe. But the underlying tone to the Lisbon bourse remained strong, they added.
*Banks were again in the spotlight, with Banco Espirito Santo gaining more than two percent after it posted better than expected first quarter results.
*Sonae Industria was up over four percent but without there being any particular explanation. The company itself carried out a heavy block sale on Tuesday, the Lisbon bourse said.
